NONE: A1 not at any time or not on any occasion
從不；從未；永不

example: We've never been to Australia.
我們從未去過澳大利亞。
I've never heard anything so ridiculous.
我從沒聽過如此荒謬的事情。
Let us never forget those who gave their lives for their country.
讓我們永遠記住那些為國捐軀的人。
Wars never solve anything.
戰爭絕不能解決任何問題。
He threatened to shoot, but I never thought (= did not think) he would.
他威脅說要開槍，但我認為他根本不會那樣做。
I never realized you knew my brother.
我從不知道你認識我兄弟。
It's never too late to start eating a healthy diet.
任何時候開始健康的飲食習慣都不算太晚。
UK informal "He's never 61! (= it's difficult to believe he's 61!) He looks so young."
「真是難以相信他61歲了！他看上去那麼年輕。」
UK not standard "You stole my drink!" "No, I never (= I didn't)."
「你偷了我的飲料！」「沒有，我沒偷。」

NONE: › do not worry
別擔心，別怕
› do not worry
別擔心！

example: Never fear, I'll take good care of him.
別擔心，我會好好照顧他的。
Never fear! I'll have that leak fixed in a few moments.
別擔心！我一會兒就把那處漏洞修補好。

NONE: › to be unable to stop feeling embarrassed about something you have done
對…感到尷尬不已，一直對…感到難堪

example: I wish I'd never opened my mouth in the meeting - I'm never going to live it down!
我真希望自己在會上甚麽都沒說——我一輩子都會為此感到難堪的！

NONE: › said to advise someone not to refuse something good that is being offered
不要拒絕別人的好意。
› to continue to be successful after doing something with a good result
持續走紅，一帆風順

example: She never looked back after that first exhibition.
自從首次展出後，她就一直很走紅。

NONE: A2 used to tell someone not to worry about something because it is not important
別擔心，沒關係
› used as a way of emphasizing that, although a particular thing is true, the one you have just mentioned is more important or interesting
（表示強調）更不用說…

example: "I'm sorry I lost that wallet you gave me." "Never mind, I can easily buy you another one."
「恐怕我把你給我的那個錢包弄丟了。」「哦，沒關係，我再給你買一個就是了。”
This is one of the best restaurants in the Northeast, never mind Boston.
這是東北部最好的飯店之一，更別說是在波士頓了。

NONE: › despite the fact that
儘管

example: He's going on holiday for the third time this year, never mind that he has hardly any money left.
儘管他的錢已經所剩無幾，他今年卻要第三次去度假了。

NONE: › said to emphasize that you should not delay doing something if you can do it immediately
今日事今日畢。
› said to encourage people to keep trying
別氣餒；別灰心
› said when two things or people are completely different, unsuitable for each other, or are unable to agree
毫無共同點
C1 Something that is never-ending never ends or seems as if it will never end.
永無止境的，沒完沒了的

example: Writing a dictionary is a never-ending task.
編寫詞典是一份永無休止的工作。

NONE: › an imaginary place where everything is pleasant or perfect in a way that is impossible to achieve in real life
世外桃源，理想樂土

example: If he thinks we can get this done by next week, he's living in never-never land.
如果他認為我們下週就能把這項工作完成的話，那他簡直是在妄想。

NONE: B2 despite what has just been said or referred to
不過，仍然；儘管如此

example: I knew a lot about the subject already, but her talk was interesting nevertheless.
關於這個話題我已經知道很多，但她的報告聽起來還是很有趣。

NONE: › belonging or relating to the island of Nevis or its people
尼維斯島的；尼維斯島人的
› a person from the island of Nevis
尼維斯島人
